target_identity_requirements: target selection must occur independently of expected diameter

outcome_contract.PASS: one target is uniquely identified, role/opening semantics are established, analytic measurement exists, and operator/tolerance comparison passes
outcome_contract.FAIL: one target is uniquely identified, role/opening semantics are established, analytic measurement exists, and comparison demonstrably fails
outcome_contract.UNVERIFIABLE: target identity, role, opening state, topology, BREP, or analytic measurement is missing or ambiguous

current_hose_requirement_audit.conclusion: The requirement is not safe to route to a cylindrical verifier. The application must not select whichever 35 mm cylinder happens to exist.
